summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Pan Administrador. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests passed (auth register/login/me/401, products CRUD, sales create+stock decrement+profit+delete-restore, expenses CRUD, dashboard for all 4 ranges + aggregations, voice/parse Gemini sale+expense, voice endpoints auth-protected). Frontend E2E via mobile viewport (390x844): welcome→register→dashboard→inventory (search+add product with margin slider auto-calc)→POS (add-to-cart, per-item editable price, checkout succeeds and updates stock + dashboard)→expenses (register operating/transporte)→reports→voice modal (manual text 'vendí un buzo por 30 en efectivo' parsed by Gemini→confirm card→saved)→settings (currency PEN→USD updates prefix, dark-mode toggle). All 15 UI flow steps completed successfully.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — RN Web deprecation, worth migrating to boxShadow to avoid future breakage.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — likely inside a Modal/Overlay component. Migrate.

action_items: (Low priority) Migrate deprecated RN-web props: replace shadow* style props with boxShadow and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents.

(Optional UX) Margin slider uses gross-margin-on-sale formula (price = cost / (1 - margin/100)); with cost 20 and margin 30, suggested price is 28.57 (rounded 29). If the intent was markup (price = cost*(1+margin)), reconsider label. Currently label says 'Margen sobre venta' or similar — verify wording matches the formula.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: current_user raises HTTPException from InvalidTokenError without `from` — minor, no impact.
server.py uses @app.on_event startup/shutdown (deprecated in FastAPI, prefer lifespan). Not blocking.
All Mongo `_id` fields are properly stringified via helper serializers — good.
Frontend correctly uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and all interactive components have testID.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates a fresh TEST_<uuid>@pan.com user; UI test also created one TEST_Buzo UI product, one sale, and one expense under the new user. No shared/prod data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://margin-master-160.preview.emergentagent.com. Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v` to re-verify. Emails are lowercased server-side (compare with .lower()). Voice mic recording is NOT testable in headless browser; use testIDs voice-manual-input + voice-manual-submit (fallback path also has voice-manual-input-2 for the permission-denied variant). Dashboard [data-testid=balance-total] only renders after at least one sale exists (empty state uses [data-testid=empty-new-sale]). Voice FAB (voice-fab) is hidden on Ventas & Gastos tabs by design.
